issues.description: Candidate 0 NRXN is a family designation (NRXN1/2/3), not a unique gene symbol; cannot be normalized, decision unresolved.
Candidate 62 NFGR normalized to standard gene symbol NGFR.

Candidates 13-15 were pooled as 'Urothelial cells' but their markers correspond to umbrella cells in Fig 1C; they are verified under umbrella cells. Candidate 16 CEACAM1 remains context_only (top DEG only).
Full-text scan identified MKI67, UPK1B, UPK3A, and CSPG4 as new formal markers not present in the candidate list or already-included total table.
